QUOTE: `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` defaults to off (`include/mbedtls/mbedtls_config.h:3787`). `MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD` and `MBEDTLS_THREADING_ALT` also default to off.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says the threading macros are off by default, but the checklist item needs the shipped config to leave both threading macros undefined, so a default build defines neither. The answer names three macros (C, PTHREAD, ALT) and never says which two the item means. It also says it could not confirm the shipped default from the index.
